comparison.objective: Remove a drawer by pressing two opposite-sense slide-release levers while pulling it outward.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual asymmetric latch actuation coordinated with constrained linear extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Both releases actuated correctly and drawer fully removed without drop or damage.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous opposed latch release and extraction from slides, not creating a flush continuation of a rail and preserving unsupported recirculating balls.
